events.verdict: DiVincenzo (MIN) and Wembanyama (SAS) get their feet tangled off ball.
Gobert (MIN) briefly engages with Wembanyama (SAS) but the contact is marginal. Gobert does not grab Wembanyama's arm and prevent him from disengaging.
DiVincenzo (MIN) deflects Paul's (SAS) pass out of bounds.
Gobert (MIN) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) grabs Gobert's (MIN) arm and the contact impedes his ability to pursue the rebound.
Vassell (SAS) and DiVincenzo (MIN) come together as they meet at the same spot on the floor. Both players are able to continue moving freely.
Edwards (MIN) legally contests Wembanyama's (SAS) dunk attempt.
Barnes (SAS) deflects the ball and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Wembanyama (SAS) attempts to avoid contact with McDaniels (MIN) and any ensuing contact is marginal. The two players make incidental foot contact, which causes McDaniels to trip.
Gobert (MIN) illegally wraps his arm around Wembanyama's (SAS) waist in order to get to the pass.
Wembanyama (SAS) does not release the free throw within ten seconds.
Sochan (SAS) commits a take foul on DiVincenzo (MIN). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
DiVincenzo (MIN) legally contests Sochan's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
